summary: Frontend-only regression + feature test of the 3 new lead-attractor tools (/tools/seller-net-sheet, /tools/ptt-estimator, /tools/mortgage-affordability), the new top-nav Tools dropdown, the footer 'Free BC Resources' column, the /mockups/first-time-buyer -> /tools/first-time-buyer redirect, sitemap-static.xml, and no-regression checks on existing conversion routes + Doogie FAB. All 3 new pages render with IdentityLine + compliance strips, client-side math verified numerically, CTAs carry correct UTM params, and no console/page errors were observed. 4 issues found: (1) Tools dropdown is unusable on touch/mobile (tap opens then immediately closes), (2) /tools/first-time-buyer still renders the 'UNLISTED PREVIEW / MOCKUP' banner and a '[Unlisted]' <title> despite being canonical + in sitemap, (3) footer links to the unlisted mockup /mockups/moving-to-bc-quiz, (4) the FTHB PTT partial-exemption formula does not match the BC rule (verified against gov.bc.ca) in both PTTEstimator.jsx and BCBuyerCostCalculator.jsx.

ui_bugs.issue: Tools dropdown cannot be opened on touch/mobile. onMouseEnter sets openMenu=true, then the same tap fires onClick which toggles it back to false, so the menu never renders. Verified at 390x844: hamburger opens nav, 'Tools ▾' is visible, tap -> [data-testid='nav-tools-menu'] count = 0 and clicking nav-tools-seller-net/nav-tools-fthb times out. On desktop a mouse click on the (hover-open) menu also closes it. The in-code comment says mobile renders a flat list under a section header, but that branch is not implemented.

Now the canonical URL (nav item, footer link, sitemap priority 0.85) but still renders the yellow strip '🔒 UNLISTED PREVIEW — ... Not linked from any navigation, blocked from search engines, and not in the sitemap.' plus a 'MOCKUP · REVIEW COPY' label and 'Sample rendering — final version will personalize...' copy. document.title = '[Unlisted] First-Time Buyer Grant & Rebate Cheat-Sheet · EZtoFind.ca'. The component has no <Helmet> at all: no meta description, no page-specific canonical/robots, no JSON-LD (unlike the other 3 tools). Public-facing copy now contradicts itself.

12 links render correctly, but 'Moving to BC Quiz' points to /mockups/moving-to-bc-quiz, which renders its own 'UNLISTED PREVIEW — parked for Doug's review. Not linked from any navigation, blocked from search engines, and not in the sitemap' banner and has no site nav/footer chrome. Either promote it to a /tools/* canonical URL (as was done for first-time-buyer) or drop it from the footer.

FTHB exemption formula does not match the BC rule (verified on gov.bc.ca / Property Transfer Tax Act, thresholds effective Apr 1 2024 and still current). Actual rule: full exemption of the PTT on the first $500,000 (max $8,000) for FMV <= $835,000, then linear phase-out between $835,000 and $860,000 using E*((835,000+25,000-FMV)/25,000); zero above $860,000. The code instead tapers linearly from $500,000 to $835,000 and returns 0 above $835,000. Observed on /tools/ptt-estimator: price $700,000 -> waiver shown $4,836 / payable $7,164 (actual: waiver $8,000 / payable $4,000); price $840,000 -> waiver $0 / payable $14,800 (actual: waiver $6,400); price $855,000 -> waiver $0 (actual: $1,600). Understates the FTHB benefit by up to ~$6,400 on a compliance-sensitive public calculator. Same defect exists in the existing BCBuyerCostCalculator (calc-fthb-waiver) so both tools are consistently wrong.

integration_issues.issue: Redirect works but is client-side only (React Router <Navigate replace>); the old URL still returns HTTP 200 with the SPA shell rather than a real 301. Spec asked for 301/redirect — acceptable for users, sub-optimal for SEO/link equity. No rel=canonical is emitted on the old URL either.

issues: No contrast/spacing/alignment problems found; IdentityLine, headshot image, inputs, results rows and compliance strips all render cleanly at 1920 and 390 widths.
Minor: PTT estimator is reachable only from the footer — it is not in the Tools nav dropdown (matches the 5-item spec, but flagged for product decision since it is the highest-intent BC search term).

action_items: Fix ToolsDropdown touch support: keep hover and click state separate (e.g. onClick={() => setOpenMenu(true)} when closed, or track pointerType), or render the flat mobile list the code comment describes. Currently mobile users cannot reach any Tools menu item.

Strip the 'UNLISTED PREVIEW' banner, 'MOCKUP · REVIEW COPY' label and '[Unlisted]' title prefix from FirstTimeBuyerCheatSheet, and add a <Helmet> block (title, meta description, robots index, canonical, JSON-LD) now that /tools/first-time-buyer is a public 0.85 sitemap URL.
Either promote /mockups/moving-to-bc-quiz to a canonical /tools/* URL (remove its unlisted banner, add to sitemap) or remove footer-res-moving-quiz from the 'Free BC Resources' column.

Correct computeFTHBExemption to the statutory BC formula (cap $8,000 / PTT on first $500K up to $835K FMV, phase-out $835K-$860K) in PTTEstimator.jsx AND BCBuyerCostCalculator.jsx, and re-check any FTHB numbers quoted in FirstTimeBuyerCheatSheet and the affordability calculator's afford-ptt output.
critical_code_review_comments: DRY: computePTT / computeFTHBExemption / computeNewBuildExemption are duplicated verbatim in PTTEstimator.jsx and BCBuyerCostCalculator.jsx (and PTT logic again inside App.js Calculators). Extract to src/utils/bcTax.js so a rate/threshold change is a single edit — this duplication is exactly why the FTHB formula bug now exists in two places.

Circular import: MortgageAffordabilityPage.jsx imports { Calculators } from '../App' while App.js lazy-imports MortgageAffordabilityPage. It works today only because the import is lazy/code-split; move Calculators into its own module (src/components/Calculators.jsx) to remove the cycle.
App.js is ~13,150 lines. The new nav dropdown/footer column additions keep growing it; split nav, footer and Calculators into separate modules.
FirstTimeBuyerCheatSheet is the only /tools/* page without a Helmet/SEO block while being listed in the sitemap — inconsistent with the compliance/SEO pattern used by the other three tools.
test_credentials: not required (no auth flows touched; /app/memory/test_credentials.md not needed for this iteration)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified PASS this iteration: (a) Tools dropdown on desktop — sits between Glossary and About, hover opens, exact order Free Market Estimate / Buyer Cost Calculator / Seller Net Sheet / Mortgage Affordability / First-Time Buyer Cheat Sheet, click navigates; (b) footer 'Free BC Resources' = 12 links, all 12 target routes render real content; (c) Seller Net Sheet math — $1,000,000 sale / $400,000 mortgage / 3%+3% / $2,500 penalty => comm $60,000, GST $3,000, net range $530,750-$533,100 (matches OTHER_COSTS low 1,400 / high 3,750); negotiable disclaimer + BCFSA strip present; CTAs /seller & /valuation with utm; (d) PTT tiered math — $1.2M = $22,000; FTHB @$500K => $0; new-build @$1.12M => waiver $12,240 / net $8,160; @$1.05M => full waiver; foreign @$1M => +$200,000, total $218,000; CTAs correct; (e) Mortgage affordability reuses App.js Calculators (afford-* testids all present), WebApplication + FAQPage JSON-LD both parse, compliance strip states REALTOR® not mortgage broker, live recompute income 150k->691,000 / 200k->907,000; (f) sitemap-static.xml has the 5 /tools/* URLs at 0.9 and 0.85 for first-time-buyer; (g) /valuation, /buyer, /seller, /referral-request render form-first with IdentityLine (forms NOT submitted — Turnstile); /contact is a chooser page with no form (pre-existing, not a regression); (h) doogie-fab is position:fixed z-index 1050 and visible on homepage. Note: homepage never reaches networkidle (live polling) — use wait_until='domcontentloaded'. After fixes, retest: mobile Tools dropdown at 390px, FTHB numbers at $600K/$700K/$840K/$855K on both PTT and Buyer Cost calculators, and the first-time-buyer page banner/title.
rca_of_the_issue: ToolsDropdown mobile failure: a single openMenu state is driven by both onMouseEnter (true) and onClick (toggle). A touch tap emits a synthetic mouseover before click, so openMenu goes true -> false within the same gesture and the menu never paints; the desktop hover path masks the bug. FTHB failure: computeFTHBExemption models the exemption as a linear taper of the whole PTT from $500K to $835K, whereas the statute exempts the PTT on the first $500,000 (max $8,000) for FMV <= $835,000 and only tapers over the $835K-$860K band; the wrong helper was copy-pasted into the new PTTEstimator from BCBuyerCostCalculator. first-time-buyer failure: the component was promoted from /mockups to /tools without removing its mockup/unlisted chrome or adding SEO metadata.
